notApplicable.size: Layout consumes available width and item measurements; control size does not alter its geometry.
notApplicable.hover: The layout has no interactive surface; child content owns interaction states.
notApplicable.selected: Selection belongs to the supplied item component.
notApplicable.disabled: The layout does not disable content.
notApplicable.error: Request and content errors belong to the consumer.
notApplicable.loading: No asynchronous data lifecycle is owned by Masonry.
